page.layout: One column of running text on the left page; the left edge of the scan is cropped, so the first letters of several lines are partly lost. Printed page number top right. Running head top centre. Signature and catchword at the foot. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: obligandum sufficientis, tum in aliquam temeritatis suæ pænam, ut discat in posterum sapere & sobriam vitam agere, ne id in se temerè admittat ebrius, quod eum sobrium ringat[?]. Sed si adimpletio promissi cedat juranti in grave damnum aut incommodum; ut siquis ebrius juraret fundum unde familiam alit venditurum vili pretio: videtur non obligari. Ob eam sc. rationem, quòd vix ullum potest esse certius indicium emotæ fede ua mentis, quàm cum quis vino faucius d' se facturum magnificè pollicetur, quod est cum suo magno malo con-unctum[?]. Quum ergo animus inter jurandum non[?] fuit plenè liber; proterea nec erit obligatio plena. Is itaque fortassis in hoc casu erit rei non bonæ exitus non pessimus, si utrāque pars, jurans sc. & is cui juratur, iri boni & prudentis arbitrio rem totam permittat: qui statuat scilicet ex circumstantiis, quotam partem par[t] jurantem ejus quod promisit, in e-rietatis[?] & ex ebrietate temeritatis pœ-am persolvere.

page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cropped: the first letters of many lines (e.g. "aque", "on bonæ", "otam", "ua mentis", "t jurantem", "rietatis") are only partly visible; the reconstructions shown are not certain. Line 'ringat' (sobrium cingat?) is doubtful. A blot over the word "non" (line 16) makes it hard to read; "non" is a guess. "unctum" at line 15 is partly cut off. The hyphenated "in e-/rietatis" is unclear. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. Printed "Ob" at line 10 may be partly cropped. The text may contain a printing error in "sc." (printed "fc."), copied as sc.
